summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing an agreement to issue C$750 million of green medium-term notes. The offering comprises C$400 million Series 21 Notes due 2036 at 4.949% and C$350 million Series 22 Notes due 2031 at 4.256%, issued by subsidiary Brookfield Renewable Partners ULC with full guarantees. The notes are rated BBB+ (S&P), BBB (high) (DBRS), and BBB+ (Fitch), and will fund eligible green investments or repay related debt. Deal closes around August 24, 2026. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
